# Third-party notices

Installed Windows dependency versions and original license/notice files are listed in dependencies.json. uv.lock and frontend/package-lock.json include remaining platform-specific resolutions. An empty notices list means no matching installed top-level notice was found, not permission to omit attribution. No license for ForestCheck itself is granted here; the owner decides distribution terms. Dependencies are installed separately; binary runtimes and third-party bundles are not redistributed in the code-demo archive.

В дополнение сохранены встроенные notices esrecurse, imurmurhash и natural-compare
из установленных исходников/README. Для CatBoost, @humanfs/types,
@rolldown/binding-win32-x64-msvc и saxes отдельный notice-файл в проверенной
установке не найден; лицензия указана по metadata, полнота бинарного комплекта
не аттестована. Их бинарники не включены в code-demo.
